The '''SY-6''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] model produced by [[Tion Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The SY-6 was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Master's Shadow Pack.
